Check colorblind safety of a Portinari palette

Source: R/colorblind.R
portinari.cvd.check.Rd

Simulates protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia (Machado et al., 2009) and measures the smallest CIELAB color difference (CIE76 dE) within the discrete palette of n colors returned by portinari.pal(), for every n. A discrete palette of n colors is colorblind-safe when all three simulations keep that minimum at or above threshold.

Usage

portinari.cvd.check(palette = "cafe", threshold = 10)

Arguments

palette

Name of the palette. See portinari.palettes().

threshold

Minimum acceptable dE. Default 10.

Value

A data frame with one row per palette size n (from 2 up to the palette length) and columns normal, protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia (minimum pairwise dE in each condition) and colorblind_safe.

Examples

portinari.cvd.check("inah")
#>   n   normal protanopia deuteranopia tritanopia colorblind_safe
#> 1 2 78.44455  74.497104     79.83796   63.96138            TRUE
#> 2 3 51.90594  51.943710     49.56295   42.11120            TRUE
#> 3 4 21.14068  17.750296     19.24980   22.25938            TRUE
#> 4 5 20.58140   7.710626     14.77495   19.39388           FALSE
